image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is black plastic with a white paper label on the top face featuring red handwritten text and some printed black text. Two circular windows reveal the white spools inside, connected by dark magnetic tape. The bottom edge shows the rectangular opening for the tape head and pinch roller access.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red handwriting on the label is stylized and largely illegible, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear human handwriting. It lacks coherent letter structures.
The plastic texture near the bottom opening appears slightly smeared or overly smooth, lacking the fine molded grain expected in macro photography of aged plastic.
The connection of the magnetic tape between the spools and the central guide posts is vague and lacks mechanical clarity, appearing as a dark blur rather than distinct tape ribbon.

Mechanical plausibility of the internal spool and tape mechanism.
Sharpness and realism of the plastic molding details (screw holes, ribs).
Boundary integrity between the spool windows and the casing.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. AI often fails to render coherent handwriting, producing scribbles that look like text from a distance but fail character-level inspection. Also, verify if the internal mechanics (spools/tape) make physical sense or if they are just 'vague dark shapes' mimicking the idea of a cassette.
